name: Silly Dragonfly 82
author: LeonKohli
description: Neon gradient pill blue text input that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #7864ff 0%,
    #7864ff 100%
  ) to linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #7864ff 0%,
    #7864ff 100%
  ), transform becomes scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 0 0 15px #7864ff. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 15px #ff64dc,
    0 0 15px #7864ff, width becomes 70%, height becomes 70%.
